verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.customer.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured doc index. Evidence also shows section-level llms.txt files (ai, messaging, accounts, integrations), an llms-full.txt, a site-level customer.io/llms.txt, Markdown doc pages, and an OpenAPI spec indexed for agents. First-party skills that teach AI assistants to drive the CLI add further agent-oriented documentation. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents consume these docs effectively.
